title: Remove 9
description:
Start from integer `1`, remove any integer that contains `9` such as `9`, `19`, `29`...

Now, you will have a new integer sequence `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, ...]`.

Given an integer `n`, return *the* `n^th` (**1-indexed**) integer in the new sequence.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Remove 9.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
